<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/plugins/{id}/settings/host/{hostId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Writes host-scope values. Requires edit access to the host, so a user who may only connect to a shared host cannot change how a plugin treats it. A value written here becomes the host's own rather than following the host defaults; list keys in `_inherit` to hand them back to the defaults.
